note: Floor, not an equality requirement, measured by the SAME metric the verifier reads: xcresulttool's test-results summary `totalTestCount`, which counts a parameterized test FUNCTION as 1 (not per-iteration). So this number is lower than the IDE's per-iteration count (e.g. 786 here vs 795 in-IDE with a 10-arg parameterized test). New tests raise it; the verifier fails when fewer execute or any test fails. Read from build/TestResults.xcresult — never from console text.
